visibleTestCases.title: Session Operations and Atomic Hit Counter
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin [case whereis(N) of undefined -> ok; P -> exit(P, kill) end || N <- [session_cache, table_manager, session_sup]], timer:sleep(20), {ok, _} = session_cache:start_pipeline(), ok = session_cache:put_session(<<"s1">>, 101, #{ip => <<"127.0.0.1">>}), {ok, 1} = session_cache:increment_hits(<<"s1">>), {ok, 2} = session_cache:increment_hits(<<"s1">>), {ok, Sess} = session_cache:get_session(<<"s1">>), Hits = maps:get(hit_count, Sess), session_cache:stop_pipeline(), Hits end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Verifies pipeline boot, insertion, and atomic counter updates.

visibleTestCases.title: Chaos Test: Kill Worker -> Zero-Data-Loss Failover
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin [case whereis(N) of undefined -> ok; P -> exit(P, kill) end || N <- [session_cache, table_manager, session_sup]], timer:sleep(20), {ok, _} = session_cache:start_pipeline(), ok = session_cache:put_session(<<"sess_a">>, 999, #{role => admin}), {ok, 1} = session_cache:increment_hits(<<"sess_a">>), OldPid = whereis(session_cache), exit(OldPid, kill), timer:sleep(60), NewPid = whereis(session_cache), {ok, SessA} = session_cache:get_session(<<"sess_a">>), session_cache:stop_pipeline(), {OldPid =/= NewPid, maps:get(hit_count, SessA)} end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Kills worker with kill signal, verifies new PID from supervisor, and confirms 100% data preservation.
